phase_title: Phase 15-7/15-8 測定ワークフロー実行可否判定レポート設計
phase_purpose: Phase 16 実測入力受領・検証層：Phase 16-7（統合検証結果）と Phase 16-3（予備判定）を受けて、Phase 15-7（integrated_decision 実測判定）と Phase 15-8（receiver_validator_permission 実測判定）の測定ワークフローを実行してよいかどうかを最終判定するレポート構造を設計する。実行可能な場合、測定ワークフロー実行へ引き渡す。
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of workflow execution feasibility judgment structure only, no actual workflow execution yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Workflow execution feasibility judgment is design-only; no actual Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement workflows are executed. No app/tests implementation permitted.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual measurement workflows are executed; only feasibility judgment design is performed.

workflow_execution_feasibility_judgment_.purpose: Determine whether Phase 15-7 (integrated_decision measurement) and Phase 15-8 (receiver_validator_permission measurement) workflows can be executed based on: (1) Phase 16-7 validation result status, (2) Phase 16-3 pre-decision update feasibility assessment, (3) overall readiness state
workflow_execution_feasibility_judgment_.judgment_timing: Immediately after Phase 16-7 validation result report is finalized
judgment_inputs: Phase 16-7 validation_final_overall_status (VALIDATION_PASSED, VALIDATION_PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS, VALIDATION_FAILED_RETURNABLE, or VALIDATION_FAILED_HALT)
Phase 16-7 validation_result_recommended_action (PROCEED, HOLD_WITH_WARNINGS, REQUEST_CORRECTION, or HALT_AND_ESCALATE)
Phase 16-3 overall_feasibility_assessment (READY_1_VALIDATION_PASSED, READY_2_PRECONDITIONS_MET, READY_WITH_CAUTION, or NOT_READY)
Current NO_GO/NOT_EFFECTIVE state of integrated_decision and receiver_validator_permission
judgment_outputs: Phase 16-8 workflow execution feasibility judgment report determining: PROCEED_TO_PHASE_15_7_15_8, HOLD_PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW, or HALT_DO_NOT_PROCEED
workflow_execution_feasibility_judgment_.downstream_consumer: Phase 15-7 (integrated_decision measurement) and Phase 15-8 (receiver_validator_permission measurement) measurement workflows

gate_1_validation_passed_requirement.requirement: Phase 16-7 validation_final_overall_status must be VALIDATION_PASSED or VALIDATION_PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS
gate_1_validation_passed_requirement.logic: IF validation_status IN [VALIDATION_PASSED, VALIDATION_PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS] THEN gate_1_PASS ELSE gate_1_FAIL
gate_1_validation_passed_requirement.rationale: Data must be validated before measurement can proceed; returnable or halt failures block measurement

gate_2_validation_action_non_blocking.requirement: Phase 16-7 validation_result_recommended_action must be PROCEED or HOLD_WITH_WARNINGS (not REQUEST_CORRECTION or HALT)
gate_2_validation_action_non_blocking.logic: IF recommended_action IN [PROCEED, HOLD_WITH_WARNINGS] THEN gate_2_PASS ELSE gate_2_FAIL
gate_2_validation_action_non_blocking.if_pass: Validation recommends proceeding or holding for review; compatible with Phase 15-7/15-8
gate_2_validation_action_non_blocking.if_fail: Validation recommends correction or escalation; cannot proceed to measurement
gate_2_validation_action_non_blocking.rationale: Returnable failures must be corrected before measurement; halt failures require escalation first

gate_3_pre_decision_feasibility.requirement: Phase 16-3 overall_feasibility_assessment must be READY_1_VALIDATION_PASSED or READY_2_PRECONDITIONS_MET (or READY_WITH_CAUTION if explicitly approved by authority)
gate_3_pre_decision_feasibility.logic: IF feasibility_status IN [READY_1_VALIDATION_PASSED, READY_2_PRECONDITIONS_MET] THEN gate_3_PASS; IF READY_WITH_CAUTION AND authority_approved THEN gate_3_PASS; ELSE gate_3_FAIL
gate_3_pre_decision_feasibility.if_pass: Pre-decision assessment confirms readiness; measurement can proceed
gate_3_pre_decision_feasibility.if_fail: Pre-decision assessment indicates not ready; measurement blocked
gate_3_pre_decision_feasibility.rationale: Phase 16-3 identifies blocking conditions (e.g., receiver_validator implementation change, app/tests drift); Phase 15-7/15-8 cannot proceed if blocking conditions exist

gate_4_no_go_state_confirmed.requirement: Current integrated_decision status must be NO_GO; current receiver_validator_permission status must be NOT_EFFECTIVE
gate_4_no_go_state_confirmed.logic: IF (integrated_decision == NO_GO AND receiver_validator_permission == NOT_EFFECTIVE) THEN gate_4_PASS ELSE gate_4_FAIL
gate_4_no_go_state_confirmed.if_pass: NO_GO/NOT_EFFECTIVE state confirmed; Phase 15-7/15-8 can attempt to measure and potentially change state
gate_4_no_go_state_confirmed.rationale: Phase 15-7/15-8 are designed to measure these two states; pre-existing EFFECTIVE or GO state would bypass gate design

gate_5_blockers_cleared.requirement: Phase 16-3 blocking_conditions_list must be empty (or all explicitly waived by authority review)
gate_5_blockers_cleared.reference: Phase 16-3 lists 6 blocking conditions: 1) receiver_validator_implementation_change, 2) app_implementation_drift, 3) tests_implementation_drift, 4) external_api_unauthorized, 5) cron_scheduled_changes, 6) active_production_deployment
gate_5_blockers_cleared.logic: IF blocking_conditions_count == 0 OR all_blockers_explicitly_waived THEN gate_5_PASS ELSE gate_5_FAIL
gate_5_blockers_cleared.if_pass: All blocking conditions cleared; Phase 15-7/15-8 can execute
gate_5_blockers_cleared.if_fail: Blocking conditions present; Phase 15-7/15-8 cannot execute
gate_5_blockers_cleared.rationale: Blocking conditions indicate system changes incompatible with measurement

decision_rule_all_gates_must_pass.rule: All five gates (GATE_VALIDATION, GATE_VALIDATION_ACTION, GATE_PRE_DECISION_ASSESSMENT, GATE_NO_GO_CONFIRMATION, GATE_PHASE_16_3_BLOCKERS) must pass for Phase 15-7/15-8 to execute
decision_rule_all_gates_must_pass.logic: IF (gate_1 AND gate_2 AND gate_3 AND gate_4 AND gate_5) THEN overall_feasibility = PROCEED_TO_PHASE_15_7_15_8 ELSE determine_halt_or_hold
decision_rule_all_gates_must_pass.rationale: Each gate represents critical readiness condition; all must be satisfied for safe measurement workflow execution

decision_rule_gate_failures.rule: If any single gate fails, Phase 15-7/15-8 cannot proceed

gates: GATE_VALIDATION_ACTION (validation action is REQUEST_CORRECTION or HALT)
failure_type_1_validation_blocking.action: Inform reviewer of validation failure; await correction or escalation resolution
failure_type_1_validation_blocking.can_proceed_after: Validation resubmitted and re-approved, or halt escalation resolved

failure_type_2_readiness_blocking.action: Escalate to human authority; list blocking conditions and readiness gaps; await decision
failure_type_2_readiness_blocking.can_proceed_after: Authority explicitly approves proceeding despite gaps, or gaps resolved

failure_type_3_state_inconsistency.action: Investigate state inconsistency; check if Phase 15-7/15-8 already executed or state changed unexpectedly

elements.validation_status_received: From Phase 16-7: VALIDATION_PASSED | VALIDATION_PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS | VALIDATION_FAILED_RETURNABLE | VALIDATION_FAILED_HALT
elements.failure_reason_if_fail: If gate failed, why (e.g., 'Validation status is VALIDATION_FAILED_RETURNABLE')

elements.validation_recommended_action_received: From Phase 16-7: PROCEED | HOLD_WITH_WARNINGS | REQUEST_CORRECTION | HALT_AND_ESCALATE
elements.failure_reason_if_fail: If gate failed, why (e.g., 'Validation recommends REQUEST_CORRECTION')

elements.pre_decision_feasibility_status_received: From Phase 16-3: READY_1_VALIDATION_PASSED | READY_2_PRECONDITIONS_MET | READY_WITH_CAUTION | NOT_READY
elements.authority_approval_for_caution: If status is READY_WITH_CAUTION: was it explicitly approved by authority? boolean
elements.failure_reason_if_fail: If gate failed, why (e.g., 'Pre-decision assessment is NOT_READY')

elements.requirement_met: boolean (both must be NO_GO and NOT_EFFECTIVE respectively)
elements.failure_reason_if_fail: If gate failed, why (e.g., 'integrated_decision is GO (unexpected)' or 'receiver_validator_permission is EFFECTIVE')

elements.blocking_conditions_detected: List of blocking conditions that are active (empty list = all cleared)
elements.explicitly_waived_conditions: List of conditions that are present but explicitly waived by authority
elements.failure_reason_if_fail: If gate failed, list of blocking conditions preventing execution

logic.PROCEED_TO_PHASE_15_7_15_8: All 5 gates PASS; Phase 15-7 (integrated_decision measurement) and Phase 15-8 (receiver_validator_permission measurement) can execute immediately
logic.HOLD_PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW: Some gates failed, but failures are not critical blockers; require human authority decision to proceed or halt
logic.HALT_DO_NOT_PROCEED: Critical gates failed (validation blocking or state inconsistency); Phase 15-7/15-8 must not execute; escalation or correction required

authority_decision_required.description: Is human authority judgment required to proceed?
authority_decision_required.condition: true if overall_feasibility is HOLD_PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW; false if PROCEED or HALT

logic.APPROVE_PROCEED: If hold reasons are acceptable, approve immediate execution
logic.APPROVE_WITH_CAUTION: If hold reasons warrant monitoring, approve with additional oversight
logic.REQUEST_CORRECTION: If validation or readiness gaps are correctable, request correction and revalidation
logic.HALT_INDEFINITELY: If halt reasons cannot be resolved, recommend indefinite halt pending future system changes

phase_15_7_handoff_condition.description: State at the moment Phase 15-7 (integrated_decision measurement) can enter

elements.phase_15_7_can_execute: boolean - true if PROCEED_TO_PHASE_15_7_15_8 or authority approved
elements.phase_15_7_entry_timestamp: Time at which Phase 15-7 begins (if approved)

phase_15_8_handoff_condition.description: State at the moment Phase 15-8 (receiver_validator_permission measurement) can enter

elements.phase_15_8_can_execute: boolean - true if PROCEED_TO_PHASE_15_7_15_8 or authority approved; typically same as Phase 15-7
elements.phase_15_8_entry_timestamp: Time at which Phase 15-8 begins (if approved)

step_3_verify_current_state.action: Check current integrated_decision and receiver_validator_permission values
step_3_verify_current_state.expected: Both should be NO_GO and NOT_EFFECTIVE respectively

step_4_evaluate_gate_1_validation.action: Check Phase 16-7 validation_status against GATE_VALIDATION requirement
step_4_evaluate_gate_1_validation.decision: PASS if status in [VALIDATION_PASSED, VALIDATION_PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS]; FAIL otherwise

step_5_evaluate_gate_2_validation_action.action: Check Phase 16-7 recommended_action against GATE_VALIDATION_ACTION requirement
step_5_evaluate_gate_2_validation_action.decision: PASS if action in [PROCEED, HOLD_WITH_WARNINGS]; FAIL otherwise

step_6_evaluate_gate_3_pre_decision_feas.action: Check Phase 16-3 overall_feasibility_assessment against GATE_PRE_DECISION_ASSESSMENT requirement
step_6_evaluate_gate_3_pre_decision_feas.decision: PASS if status in [READY_1_VALIDATION_PASSED, READY_2_PRECONDITIONS_MET] or (READY_WITH_CAUTION AND authority_approved); FAIL otherwise

step_7_evaluate_gate_4_no_go_confirmatio.action: Check current integrated_decision == NO_GO AND current receiver_validator_permission == NOT_EFFECTIVE
step_7_evaluate_gate_4_no_go_confirmatio.decision: PASS if both true; FAIL if either false

step_8_evaluate_gate_5_blockers_cleared.action: Check Phase 16-3 blocking_conditions_list length and waiver status
step_8_evaluate_gate_5_blockers_cleared.decision: PASS if length == 0 or all active conditions explicitly waived; FAIL if blocking conditions present and unwaived

step_9_synthesize_gate_outcomes.action: Combine gate results using decision_rule_all_gates_must_pass logic
step_9_synthesize_gate_outcomes.logic: If all 5 gates PASS → PROCEED; If failures in validation (gates 1-2) → HALT; If failures in readiness (gates 3, 5) → HOLD; If failure in state (gate 4) → HALT

step_11_generate_handoff_report.action: Generate phase_16_8_workflow_execution_feasibility_judgment_report with all gate evaluations and recommendation

step_12_if_proceed_initiate_phase_15_7.action: If PROCEED_TO_PHASE_15_7_15_8, immediately prepare Phase 15-7 (integrated_decision measurement) workflow entry
step_12_if_proceed_initiate_phase_15_7.handoff: Pass actual_measurement_input_data to Phase 15-7 measurement logic

step_13_if_hold_escalate_to_authority.action: If HOLD_PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW, escalate to human authority with detailed gate failure report
step_13_if_hold_escalate_to_authority.escalation_content: List of failed gates, reasons, blocking conditions, recommended actions

step_14_if_halt_preserve_evidence.action: If HALT_DO_NOT_PROCEED, preserve all gate evaluation evidence and halt immediately

example_1_proceed.scenario: All validations pass, no blockers, pre-decision ready, state correct
example_1_proceed.next_action: Immediately initiate Phase 15-7 and 15-8 measurement workflows

example_2_hold_with_warnings.scenario: Validation passed with warnings, pre-decision ready with caution, state correct, blockers cleared but caution needed
example_2_hold_with_warnings.next_action_if_approved: Proceed to Phase 15-7/15-8 with additional monitoring; Phase 16-3 caution notes apply

example_3_halt_validation_failed.scenario: Validation failed with returnable errors; data must be corrected
example_3_halt_validation_failed.reason: Validation recommends data correction; Phase 15-7/15-8 cannot proceed until data revalidated
example_3_halt_validation_failed.next_action: Return data to reviewer for correction; resubmit via Phase 16-1; restart validation sequence

example_4_halt_validation_tamper.scenario: Validation failed due to detected tampering; security issue
example_4_halt_validation_tamper.reason: Data integrity failure detected; potential tampering; escalation required
example_4_halt_validation_tamper.next_action: Do not proceed to Phase 15-7/15-8; escalate to security authority; preserve forensic evidence

example_5_hold_blocker_present.scenario: Pre-decision assessment identifies blocking condition (e.g., app_implementation_drift detected)
example_5_hold_blocker_present.reason: Pre-decision assessment detected app implementation changes; system state unstable
example_5_hold_blocker_present.recommended_authority_action: REQUEST_CORRECTION_AND_REVALIDATION (or approve proceeding if app drift is acceptable)
example_5_hold_blocker_present.next_action_if_approved: If authority approves despite drift, proceed to Phase 15-7/15-8; if not, halt until app state stabilized

example_6_halt_state_inconsistency.scenario: Current integrated_decision is GO (unexpected); state inconsistency
example_6_halt_state_inconsistency.reason: State inconsistency: integrated_decision should be NO_GO at Phase 16-8 entry; if already GO, Phase 15-7 already executed
example_6_halt_state_inconsistency.next_action: Investigate state change; check Phase 15-7 execution logs; clarify current system state before proceeding

depends_on: Phase 16-7: Actual measurement input validation result report (provides validation_final_overall_status and validation_result_recommended_action)
Phase 16-3: Pre-decision update feasibility assessment (provides overall_feasibility_assessment and blocking_conditions_list)
Phase 15-7 and 15-8 current state snapshots (to verify NO_GO and NOT_EFFECTIVE)
feeds_into: Phase 15-7: integrated_decision measurement workflow (receives PROCEED or HALT decision)
Phase 15-8: receiver_validator_permission measurement workflow (receives PROCEED or HALT decision)
Phase 16-9: Phase 16 completion declaration (receives workflow execution feasibility judgment)

design_review_checklist: Five gates (GATE_VALIDATION, GATE_VALIDATION_ACTION, GATE_PRE_DECISION_ASSESSMENT, GATE_NO_GO_CONFIRMATION, GATE_PHASE_16_3_BLOCKERS) all designed and documented
All gates must pass for PROCEED_TO_PHASE_15_7_15_8
Report structure includes all gate evaluations and overall feasibility result
Handoff conditions for Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 explicitly defined
Authority judgment pathway clearly specified (when needed and what for)
Examples cover PROCEED, HOLD_WITH_WARNINGS, HALT_VALIDATION, HALT_TAMPERING, HOLD_BLOCKER, and HALT_STATE_INCONSISTENCY scenarios
Phase 16-3 blocking conditions (all 6 types) referenced and evaluated
All blocked actions remain in governance

completion_gate.gate_condition: Workflow execution feasibility judgment design approved AND gate evaluation logic finalized
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 16 design authority + Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement workflow authority
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 16-9 (Phase 16 completion declaration) can finalize once Phase 16-8 feasibility judgment design is approved
